scope: read-only controller and actual local producer response boundary; no network URLs visited or server-compromise assumption

probes.expect: invalid response field cannot leave partial old/new anatomy presented as completed
input edit/Clear/mode/exit invalidates pending response and old detail
ordinary fetch/JSON error cannot expose private raw input through error.message; compare actual producer fixed error contract
actual host/count/port limits agree with accepted response contract; distinguish missing validation hardening from reproducible producer bug
nonfinite/negative/oversized counts or host controls not silently presented as real inspected components; malformed-response tests are robustness, not a compromise claim

limits: tiny local mocks/constructed requests only; no browserupload, models, privatefiles or remote fetch
